comment: The catalogue of installable plugins. This file is embedded into the binary,
so it is the answer to 'what can I install' on every machine, with no file to
go missing at run time. It is NOT the enabled set: that is config `plugins`
plus the --plugins flag, and what is actually in a binary is plugins.Compiled().
kind 'go'     — compiled in behind the build tag plugin_<name>.
kind 'python' — a folder under plugins/ served by the shared Python host, so
every one of them needs the single tag plugin_remote.
tier 'core'   — in this repository, arrived by pull request, and the agent may
tier 'community' — carries source + commit. Adding one is an operator action:
the agent must never fetch and compile code it chose itself.

plugins.name: pdf
plugins.description: Extract text from PDF files, and read PDF bodies fetched from the web

plugins.name: webreader
plugins.description: Read pages that need JavaScript to render, as web_fetch's heavier re-read path

plugins.name: illustrator
plugins.description: Image geometry and colour for print, preserving EXIF, the ICC profile and dpi
